statements: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground

CREATE TABLE sqltide_playground.playground_orders
(
    order_id UInt64,
    status String,
    total_cents Int64,
    _replay_partition Int32,
    _replay_offset Int64,
    _replay_timestamp DateTime64(3)
)
ENGINE = MergeTree()
ORDER BY (_replay_partition, _replay_offset)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_schema_versions (
    version UInt64,
    applied_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC')
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (version)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_virtual_object_state (
    state_id String,
    observation_id String,
    state_kind LowCardinality(String),
    deployment_id Nullable(String),
    logical_database_name Nullable(String),
    logical_object_type String,
    logical_object_name String,
    physical_database_name Nullable(String),
    physical_relation_name Nullable(String),
    logical_model_database Nullable(String),
    logical_model_name Nullable(String),
    is_selected_root Bool,
    object_fingerprint String,
    canonical_query Nullable(String),
    observed_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC')
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (state_kind, state_id, logical_object_type, logical_object_name)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_virtual_deployments (
    deployment_id String,
    workflow_fingerprint String,
    replay_lineage_mode String,
    boundary_time DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),
    created_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),
    tool_version String
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (deployment_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_virtual_replay_boundaries (
    deployment_id String,
    root_database_name Nullable(String),
    root_object_type String,
    root_object_name String,
    anchor_database_name Nullable(String),
    anchor_object_type String,
    anchor_object_name String,
    boundary_kind LowCardinality(String),
    value_kind LowCardinality(String),
    partition_value Nullable(String),
    lower_value Nullable(String),
    cutoff_value String,
    cutoff_inclusive Bool,
    captured_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC')
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (deployment_id, root_object_type, root_object_name, boundary_kind, ifNull(partition_value, ''))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_virtual_publications (
    publication_id String,
    deployment_id String,
    operation LowCardinality(String) DEFAULT 'promote',
    previous_deployment_id Nullable(String),
    logical_database_name String,
    logical_view_name String,
    physical_database_name String,
    physical_relation_name String,
    published_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC')
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (publication_id, logical_database_name, logical_view_name)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_direct_fingerprints (
    fingerprint_id String,
    logical_model_identity String,
    definition_sql String,
    definition_hash String,
    identity_metadata String,
    workflow_id String,
    tool_version String,
    applied_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC')
) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (logical_model_identity, applied_at, fingerprint_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_invocations (
    invocation_id String,
    project_identity String,
    target_identity String,
    command LowCardinality(String),
    mode Nullable(String),
    outcome LowCardinality(String),
    exit_code Int32,
    materialized_outcome Nullable(String),
    deployment_id Nullable(String),
    workflow_id Nullable(String),
    selected_node_count UInt64,
    started_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),
    completed_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),
    duration_ms UInt64,
    error_message Nullable(String),
    summary_json String,
    tool_version String
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (project_identity, target_identity, completed_at, invocation_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_node_results (
    result_id String,
    invocation_id String,
    node_kind LowCardinality(String),
    node_name String,
    binding_key String,
    definition_fingerprint String,
    execution_fingerprint String,
    target_identity String,
    trigger LowCardinality(String),
    scheduled_for Nullable(DateTime64(3, 'UTC')),
    cadence_seconds Nullable(UInt64),
    warmup_seconds UInt64,
    status LowCardinality(String),
    severity Nullable(String),
    failure_count UInt64,
    completed_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),
    payload_json String,
    error_message Nullable(String)
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (node_kind, node_name, completed_at, result_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_run_events (
    invocation_id String,
    sequence UInt64,
    emitted_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC') DEFAULT now64(3, 'UTC'),
    event_kind LowCardinality(String),
    step_id Nullable(String),
    phase Nullable(String),
    payload_json String
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (invocation_id, sequence)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_run_statements (
    invocation_id String,
    statement_sequence UInt64,
    step_id String,
    phase LowCardinality(String),
    intent LowCardinality(String),
    sql String,
    sql_sha256 FixedString(64),
    workflow_sha256 FixedString(64),
    workflow_revision UInt64,
    recorded_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC') DEFAULT now64(3, 'UTC')
) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(workflow_revision)
ORDER BY (invocation_id, statement_sequence)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_sensor_checkpoints (
    sensor_name String,
    source LowCardinality(String),
    position_completed_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),
    position_result_id String,
    recorded_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC') DEFAULT now64(3, 'UTC')
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (sensor_name, source, position_completed_at, position_result_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_sensor_ticks (
    tick_id String,
    sensor_name String,
    definition_fingerprint String,
    kind LowCardinality(String),
    event_id Nullable(String),
    event_kind Nullable(String),
    attempt UInt32,
    status LowCardinality(String),
    started_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),
    completed_at Nullable(DateTime64(3, 'UTC')),
    error_message Nullable(String),
    skip_reason Nullable(String),
    cursor Nullable(String)
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (sensor_name, started_at, tick_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_sensor_steps (
    sensor_name String,
    event_id String,
    step_key String,
    policy LowCardinality(String),
    status LowCardinality(String),
    attempt UInt32,
    result_json Nullable(String),
    error_message Nullable(String),
    recorded_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC') DEFAULT now64(3, 'UTC')
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (sensor_name, event_id, step_key, recorded_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_sensor_overrides (
    override_id String,
    sensor_name String,
    status LowCardinality(String),
    actor Nullable(String),
    changed_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC') DEFAULT now64(3, 'UTC')
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (sensor_name, changed_at, override_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_sensor_leases (
    lease_name String,
    owner_id String,
    acquired_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),
    expires_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC')
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (lease_name, acquired_at, owner_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_dead_letters (
    model_name String,
    failed_columns Array(String),
    payload String,
    kafka_partition Nullable(Int32),
    kafka_offset Nullable(Int64),
    quarantined_at DateTime64(3)
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (model_name, quarantined_at)
TTL toDateTime(quarantined_at) + INTERVAL 30 DAY

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_manifests (
    manifest_id String,
    invocation_id String,
    project_identity String,
    target_name String,
    target_database String,
    is_production Bool,
    project_revision Nullable(String),
    manifest_fingerprint String,
    manifest_version UInt64,
    pipelines Array(String),
    resources Array(Tuple(
        pipeline_name String,
        logical_type String,
        logical_name String,
        resource_role String,
        resource_database String,
        resource_name String,
        resource_kind String
    )),
    tool_version String,
    published_at DateTime64(6, 'UTC')
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (project_identity, target_name, target_database, published_at, manifest_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_virtual_deployment_progress (
    deployment_id String,
    stage LowCardinality(String),
    recorded_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC')
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (deployment_id, stage)
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_owned_resources

ALTER TABLE sqltide_playground._sqltide_virtual_publications ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS operation LowCardinality(String) DEFAULT 'promote' AFTER deployment_id, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS previous_deployment_id Nullable(String) AFTER operation

INSERT INTO sqltide_playground.tbl__order_report__{{d:v1}}
WITH cutoff_offsets AS (
SELECT toInt64(partition_value) AS _replay_partition, max(toInt64(cutoff_value)) AS cutoff_offset, true AS cutoff_inclusive
FROM sqltide_playground._sqltide_virtual_replay_boundaries
WHERE deployment_id = '{{d:v1}}' AND root_object_name = 'tbl__order_report' AND boundary_kind = 'offsets'
GROUP BY _replay_partition
),
filtered_replay_source AS (
SELECT anchor.order_id AS order_id, anchor.status AS status, anchor.total_cents AS total_cents, anchor._replay_partition AS _replay_partition, anchor._replay_offset AS _replay_offset, anchor._replay_timestamp AS _replay_timestamp
FROM sqltide_playground.playground_orders AS anchor
INNER JOIN cutoff_offsets
ON anchor._replay_partition = cutoff_offsets._replay_partition
WHERE ((cutoff_offsets.cutoff_inclusive AND anchor._replay_offset <= cutoff_offsets.cutoff_offset) OR (NOT cutoff_offsets.cutoff_inclusive AND anchor._replay_offset < cutoff_offsets.cutoff_offset))
)
SELECT
  order_id::UInt64 AS order_id,
  status::String AS status,
  total_cents::Int64 AS total_cents,
  _replay_partition::Int32 AS _replay_partition,
  _replay_offset::Int64 AS _replay_offset
FROM filtered_replay_source

)

  status::String AS status,
  total_cents::Int64 AS total_cents,
  _replay_partition::Int32 AS _replay_partition,
  _replay_offset::Int64 AS _replay_offset

  status::String AS status,
  total_cents::Int64 AS total_cents,
  _replay_partition::Int32 AS _replay_partition,
  _replay_offset::Int64 AS _replay_offset

INSERT INTO sqltide_playground.tbl__order_report__{{d:built}}
WITH cutoff_offsets AS (
SELECT toInt64(partition_value) AS _replay_partition, max(toInt64(cutoff_value)) AS cutoff_offset, true AS cutoff_inclusive
FROM sqltide_playground._sqltide_virtual_replay_boundaries
WHERE deployment_id = '{{d:built}}' AND root_object_name = 'tbl__order_report' AND boundary_kind = 'offsets'
GROUP BY _replay_partition
),
active_start_offsets AS (
SELECT _replay_partition AS _replay_partition, max(_replay_offset) AS start_offset FROM sqltide_playground.playground_orders WHERE _replay_timestamp <= toDateTime64('{{s:s3}}', 3, 'UTC') GROUP BY _replay_partition
),
filtered_replay_source AS (
SELECT anchor.order_id AS order_id, anchor.status AS status, anchor.total_cents AS total_cents, anchor._replay_partition AS _replay_partition, anchor._replay_offset AS _replay_offset, anchor._replay_timestamp AS _replay_timestamp
FROM sqltide_playground.playground_orders AS anchor
INNER JOIN cutoff_offsets
ON anchor._replay_partition = cutoff_offsets._replay_partition
LEFT JOIN active_start_offsets
ON anchor._replay_partition = active_start_offsets._replay_partition
WHERE ((cutoff_offsets.cutoff_inclusive AND anchor._replay_offset <= cutoff_offsets.cutoff_offset) OR (NOT cutoff_offsets.cutoff_inclusive AND anchor._replay_offset < cutoff_offsets.cutoff_offset))
  AND (active_start_offsets.start_offset IS NULL OR anchor._replay_offset >= active_start_offsets.start_offset)
)
SELECT
  order_id::UInt64 AS order_id,
  status::String AS status,
  total_cents::Int64 AS total_cents,
  _replay_partition::Int32 AS _replay_partition,
  _replay_offset::Int64 AS _replay_offset
FROM filtered_replay_source
WHERE status = 'completed'
